claims.assertion: Yazhi said medical pods can treat many illnesses, but cancer or other strongly psychosomatic conditions may recur unless the underlying cause is addressed.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said repeated cancer treatments may be followed by faster recurrence.

claims.assertion: Yazhi said involuntary pod treatment can reset a body toward its genetic template, but may leave psychological trauma.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi said a medical pod does not require zero-point energy; a suitable electrical supply, potentially an ordinary household outlet, could power it.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said the pod itself uses relatively little energy.

coverage_gaps: genetic mapping and physical condition limits
